answer: New identities start at zero and cannot borrow history, so a sybil swarm must fund every fake agent from a cold lagoon of capital it risks losing to slashing. Each agent must stake tokens behind a verifiable identity anchored to a physical harbor registration, building reputation on a public ledge of past epochs. Coordinated fake identities therefore cost linearly while honest peers gain compounding trust. In practice, sa0037 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
